contentItem.title: 平方数
contentItem.englishTitle: A square number is equal multiplied by equal, or a number which is contained by two equal numbers.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A square number is equal multiplied by equal, or a number which is contained by two equal numbers.
A 平方数 乘以相等,或以两个相等的数字组成数字。
